title: Comments from our cleaning clients
p: Guests book Eko Čišćenje for steam cleaning and eco-friendly care in Zagreb, Samobor, Velika Gorica, Zapresic, Sveta Nedelja, Dugo Selo, Jastrebarsko, Karlovac, Krapina and Sisak.

testimonials.quote: Booking was straightforward, and the sofa looked noticeably cleaner afterward. There was no strong chemical smell.
testimonials.name: Anna M.

testimonials.quote: The office chairs were cleaned within the agreed time. The upholstery was dry enough to use by the end of the appointment.
testimonials.name: Mark T.

testimonials.quote: We wanted a service with fewer harsh chemicals. The room looked well cared for and did not retain a strong cleaning odor.
testimonials.name: Emily K.

testimonials.quote: The mattress felt fresher after the steam cleaning. The process and the products used were explained before they started.
testimonials.name: Tom L.

testimonials.quote: A few marks on the sofa came out better than I expected. The team was punctual and took care around our furniture.
testimonials.name: Sarah R.
